settings.update.heading: Updates
settings.update.subtitle: Check GitHub (eyssen/eyas) for a newer release. Self-update always creates a fresh backup first — Backup must be working.

settings.page.appearance.heading: Appearance
settings.page.appearance.themeDesc: Switch between dark and light mode
settings.page.appearance.languageDesc: Interface language (English base, translations applied where available)
settings.page.appearance.templateDesc: Visual theme applied across the app
settings.autonomy.heading: Autonomy & self-improvement
settings.autonomy.subtitle: Background self-improvement loops. Enabled ones make paid LLM calls on a schedule (or when triggered) using your configured model provider. All are off by default — enabling any of them is your choice, and you can turn them off again at any time.
settings.autonomy.loop.proactiveHeartbea: Composes proactive briefings when things need your attention.
settings.autonomy.loop.nightlyReflection: Runs a nightly self-reflection pass to spot improvements in how the assistant is working.
settings.autonomy.loop.forgeProposals.de: Proposes tool/skill improvements learned from friction — still needs your approval before anything changes.
settings.autonomy.loop.selfLearning.desc: Proposes prompt/routing tweaks learned from usage metrics — still needs your approval before anything changes.
settings.autonomy.loop.skillAdoption.des: Proposes new skills learned from repeated patterns — still needs your approval before anything changes.
settings.hands.title: Connected Hands
settings.hands.subtitle: Manage EYAS Hand clients connected to this server
settings.hands.expiresIn: Expires in {{minutes}} minutes — enter this code on your Hand device
settings.hands.emptyHint: Generate a pairing code and connect an EYAS Hand client
settings.modelAssignments.heading: Model Assignments
settings.modelAssignments.subtitle: Assign a model to each built-in agent. Available after setup as the authenticated replacement for the first-run wizard step.
settings.godMode.heading: God Mode
settings.godMode.subtitle: Models that race the same task. Mark a chair when the count is even.
settings.godMode.chairRequired: A chair is required for an even number of models.
settings.prompt.title: System Prompt
settings.prompt.subtitle: These sections form the foundation of every AI conversation. Locked sections cannot be modified.
settings.promptsList.title: Prompt Templates
settings.promptsList.subtitle: Configure system prompt templates for the prompt inheritance chain
settings.teamAgents.heading: Team Agents
settings.teamAgents.subtitle: Add built-in specialist agents. Authenticated replacement for the first-run wizard step.
settings.dataPort.heading: Data portability
settings.dataPort.subtitle: Import memory, skills and rules from previous AI systems. Export is coming later.
settings.dataPort.exportSoon: Export will produce an eyas-export-v1 bundle (vault, skills, workspaces).
settings.dataPort.wizard.title: Import data
settings.dataPort.wizard.pathHint: Absolute path on this machine. Good starts: …/Obsidian Vault/99_Meta/ai-memory, ~/.claude/skills, ~/.grok/memory
settings.dataPort.wizard.uploadHint: ZIP of a prior export, or a single markdown/JSON file
settings.dataPort.wizard.instructionsHin: Describe what to look for — tools, paths, memory vs skills. This guides ranking and the AI classifier.
settings.dataPort.wizard.instructionsPla: e.g. Claude and Grok memory should be under Obsidian; custom skills live in Claude…
settings.dataPort.wizard.needInput: Provide a server path or upload a file.
settings.dataPort.wizard.needSelection: Select at least one item to import.
settings.dataPort.wizard.resizeHint: Drag the bottom-right corner to resize
settings.dataPort.wizard.emptyScan: Nothing importable found in this location.
settings.dataPort.wizard.proposalsHint: Rules and identity files are never auto-merged. Approve to append into the agent workspace.
